info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: health reports that the notify send surface is alive.
get.description:
health reports that the notify send surface is alive.

It is a pure liveness probe, taking no credential and reading no provider.
The body mirrors notifyd's own verbatim, so probes that keyed on it keep
working unchanged.

service.description: Service is always "notify" — which subsystem answered.

status.description: Status is always "ok": the route answers 200 whenever the process is alive.
